tasks.label: Build & Deploy to OpenRGB AppData
tasks.command: & '${workspaceFolder}\build.bat'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $dst = "$env:APPDATA\OpenRGB\plugins\OpenRGBAudioRefreshPlugin.dll"; try { Copy-Item -Force '${workspaceFolder}\build\OpenRGBAudioRefreshPlugin.dll' $dst -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Move-Item -Path $dst -Destination "$env:TEMP\OpenRGBAudioRefreshPlugin_$(Get-Date -Format 'HHmmss').dll.old" -Force; Copy-Item -Force '${workspaceFolder}\build\OpenRGBAudioRefreshPlugin.dll' $dst }; Write-Host 'Deployed to %APPDATA%\OpenRGB\plugins\OpenRGBAudioRefreshPlugin.dll' }
